# Pinned versions of the static scan-wall tools. Single source of truth so Dependabot
# can propose bumps here and CI (scanner-selftest.yml) proves each bump still detects.
#
# guarddog and semgrep are a COMPATIBLE PAIR: guarddog runs its malware rules through
# semgrep, and a mismatched semgrep makes those rules silently error and find nothing.
# Bump them together; the self-test will fail a bump that breaks detection.
bandit==1.9.4
semgrep==1.172.0
pip-audit==2.10.1
guarddog==3.1.0
